project.name: TraceMail AI
project.title: AI-Powered Email Threat Detection, GeoLocation and Forensic Intelligence Platform
project.ministry_organization: Ministry of Home Affairs / Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C)

capabilities: RFC-822 / MIME multipart unrolling (mixed, alternative, related)
Reverse chronological Received hop traversal (bottom-to-top)
Spoof-resistant Trusted MTA Boundary IP resolution
Attachment cryptographic hashing (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256)
Quoted-printable sanitization & URL unmasking
Native in-process Groq Cloud LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instant inference
Zero inter-process latency (no external daemon needed)
Cognitive deception and emotional urgency classification
BEC wire fraud and payroll diversion identification
Deterministic Scikit-Learn TF-IDF local fallback if offline
Great-Circle Haversine transit flight path calculations
Dynamic Node Attribution: Emerald (#10b981) for verified senders vs Crimson (#ef4444) for hostile attackers
Interactive Leaflet GeoJSON client-side rendering
Intermediate relay hop latency & country tracking
Google Workspace / Gmail OAuth 2.0 token management & refresh
APScheduler 3-minute asynchronous background polling
Two-Tier Analysis: Tier 1 fast triage (<150ms) vs Tier 2 deep forensics (1.2-2.8s)
Auto-claim binding of unowned OAuth mailboxes (Fix 5ba70cb)
Master SHA-256 custody seal generation: SHA-256(Raw || Canonical || Timestamp)
Real-time dynamic bit-level tamper verification endpoint (/api/evidence/{id}/verify)
Court-admissible custody chain records with immutable timestamps

recent_hardening_fixes.title: fix(inbox): auto-claim unowned OAuth mailboxes and resolve 403 authorization on inbox scan
recent_hardening_fixes.impact: Eliminated 403 Forbidden errors when scanning connected Gmail mailboxes by auto-binding unowned accounts to the authenticated analyst.

recent_hardening_fixes.title: fix(maps): dynamically label origin node and route as Sender vs Attacker based on investigation verdict
recent_hardening_fixes.impact: Prevented legitimate senders from being mislabeled as hostile attackers on the interactive world map.

recent_hardening_fixes.title: fix(forensics): harden database ingestion against oversized URLs and headers, resolve 500 error on live message investigation
recent_hardening_fixes.impact: Widened PostgreSQL columns to TEXT and added defensive slicing, preventing StringDataRightTruncation crashes on tracking links >500 chars.

recent_hardening_fixes.title: docs: add comprehensive Master Project Report (PDF & Markdown) for SIH 26106
recent_hardening_fixes.impact: Added 16-section technical documentation suite and architectural diagrams.
